instruction: Customize VLC interface slider colors to use a dark color scheme

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires customizing VLC slider colors to dark scheme via Tools > Preferences > Interface > Customize Colors. Uses existing check_qt_slider_colours metric with 'blackish' type to verify all RGB values are below threshold (<100) in qt-slider-colours config.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if all slider colors have RGB values <100 (blackish), 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) which stores the qt-slider-colours setting
Metric correctly parses semicolon-separated RGB values from qt-slider-colours config string
Verification logic correctly validates ALL slider colors (not just one) have RGB values < 100, which is a reasonable threshold for 'dark color scheme' (< 40% of max intensity)
Complete coverage: instruction requires dark color scheme, evaluator verifies all colors are blackish
State is accessible: VLC config file persists after user saves preferences, no postconfig needed
Binary scoring (1.0 or 0.0) is appropriate for this yes/no verification task
